sn47.95-104:1.1: Pañcimani bhikkhave uddhambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni || katamāni pañca || Rūparāgo arūparāgo māno uddhaccam avijjā || || Imāni kho bhikkhave pañcuddhambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni || || Imesam kho bhikkhave pañcannam uddhambhāgiyānam saṃyojanānam abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya cattāro satipaṭṭhānā bhāvetabbā
sn47.95-104:2.1: ||katame cattāro || || Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassam || Vedanāsu || Citte || Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || Imesam kho bhikkhave pañcannam uddhambhāgiyānam saṃyojanānam abhiññāya pariññāya parikkhayāya pahānāya ime cattāro satipatthānā bhāvetabbāti || || [Uddānam] Ogho Yogo
